card.name: Inside warning-section terms and names
card.fires_on: Partway through words or phrases in warnings text, such as the end of ELDERLY, the second word of a condition like sexual dysfunction or congestive heart failure, or the first letter of an abbreviation like MDD.

modes.label: Condition phrases
modes.description: The word inside a named condition within a warning, just before the phrase is completed.
modes.example: may cause symptoms of sexual<< dysfunction>> ( see ADVERSE REACTIONS ).

modes.label: Split names and abbreviations
modes.description: A piece of a capitalized word, drug name or abbreviation in a warning heading or sentence.
modes.example: WARNINGS Clinical Worsening and Suicide Risk Patients with major depressive disorder (<<M>>DD), both adult and pediatric, may

modes.label: Linking word before patients
modes.description: A small linking word leading into a patient group at risk.
modes.example: Symptomatic hypotension is possible, particularly<< in>> patients with severe aortic stenosis

card.writes: No clear theme; it suppresses words of acceptance and hesitancy such as acceptance, hesitant and cautious.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of warning phrases, such as condition names, abbreviations and patient groups at risk.
